_README: Copy to HOST-EVIDENCE.json and fill it during the host session. Validate with: php scripts/hosting-verification/validate-host-evidence.php — it refuses a 404 recorded as a PASS, a gate silently omitted, a capability inferred from CI, and a file that claims cutover_ready it has not earned. Leave a gate as HOST ACTION REQUIRED rather than guessing: an honest open gate costs a day, a wrong PASS costs the audit log.
_rules: A PASS needs measured_at, method and the VERBATIM result. Paste what the host returned.
method must name how it was measured on the host. CI, 'inferred', 'assumed' and 'prior' are refused for host gates.
A 404 is never a PASS. It means the probe or bait was absent — RUN-SHEET.md §4a.
Composite gates (M1, G0-F, M3) need every named part. One green part is not the gate.
Do not set cutover_ready true until every gate is PASS.

C-5.result: Static export served by Apache/Plesk. No Plesk Node application. Artifact built by CI: 689 files, 186 _next, 4 shells, no server.js.
C-5.notes: Repository gate, not a host gate.

Q6.result: GitHub Actions scheduled workflow, .github/workflows/cron.yml. Decision table verified against 10 response cases.
Q6.notes: This records only that the caller was CHOSEN. Q6-x is whether it runs.

Q6-x.notes: Three steps: add ETHR_CRON_TOKEN and ETHR_CRON_BASE_URL to the GitHub 'production' environment; run via workflow_dispatch and paste BOTH endpoint responses; then note that the schedule: trigger only fires once cron.yml is on the default branch. A green manual dispatch is NOT evidence the schedule fires — record those as two separate facts.

M1.notes: RUN-SHEET.md §0. fl_deny: GET /ethr-canary/secret.env.probe — paste the status. 403 = pass, 200 = blocks deployment on EVERY branch, 404 = NOT RUN (the bait is absent, you are looking at the old canary). csp_survival: count the security headers on /ethr-canary/canary.php — 7 expected, 3 means the 2026-09-18 revision is still deployed.

M2.notes: Run ethr-hosting-check.php on the account WITH database credentials. Use --json and attach the output as host-evidence/probe-<date>.json rather than retyping it. Closes G0-E extensions/limits, and feeds G0-F, G0-H, G0-I and most of G0-J.

G0-F.notes: All three — G0-F-CREATE-TRIGGER.md §5. db4: the probe's CREATE TRIGGER test, or the four-statement check in §4b. show_triggers: SHOW TRIGGERS LIKE 'audit_log' must list audit_log_no_update AND audit_log_no_delete. update_refused: an UPDATE against audit_log must fail with 1644 (45000). A grant is the input; the refused UPDATE is the outcome. Do not close this from SHOW GRANTS alone.

G0-B.6.notes: Deploy the rendered .htaccess and fetch a page. Without DirectorySlash Off, mod_dir 301s /admin before the SPA rules and 20+ routes are dead. Paste the status for /admin AND for /dashboard. The local Apache harness ran under AllowOverride All — the permissive case — so it proves nothing here. No workaround exists if this fails.

M6.notes: The nine steps in M6-RESTORE-REHEARSAL.md. Record: before/after table, row and trigger counts from the census; the audit_log INSERT result VERBATIM (that string is the DEFINER failure's signature); and one real write through the application, not through SQL. A backup file existing does not close this. Neither does the application merely booting.

M3.notes: All four. dns and served_certificate already pass in isolation and NEITHER is the gate — what is absent is vhost binding: a tenant hostname currently 303s to /login.php under the lin6.ethiotelecom.et certificate. tenant_routing: a real tenant subdomain must reach ETHR, not the panel.

G0-H.notes: Ports 587/465 outbound from the probe, plus the mailbox send cap from the panel. Nothing in the code respects a send cap and NotifyAnnouncementAudienceJob / SendApprovalRemindersJob both fan out, so the cap is a real number to know.

G0-I.notes: SELECT VERSION() verbatim, the server charset, and which driver it implies. This DECIDES DB_CONNECTION: a MariaDB banner means mariadb, a MySQL banner means mysql. api/.env.shared-hosting.example ships mariadb and is annotated 'VERIFY against the host'. The devices VIRTUAL generated column needs 5.7.6+ / 10.2.1+.

G0-J.notes: The probe's Performance section (P1–P6). Related but separate: payroll runs inside the 50-second queue:work window against a budget of 500 employees < 30s measured on DEDICATED hardware, so a slow shared CPU is a product question, not just a number.

Quotas.notes: Disk and bandwidth as the panel reports them, AND the deployment's footprint against them. BACKUP_KEEP=2 with prune-after-create means four copies of the document store at peak. A full quota presents as data corruption, not an outage: writes fail, reads succeed, logs fail first, /api/v1/health still returns 200.

Secrets.method: repository audit — git ls-files, git grep, tar listing of the built artifact
Secrets.result: No real .env tracked (src/.env.production is NEXT_PUBLIC_* only, deliberately tracked). No Laravel key literal in the tree. Every env template has empty credential values. No workflow prints a secret. api.tar.gz verified to carry no .env, by a check in deploy.sh after the first exclusion patch silently failed.
Secrets.notes: Outstanding, and NOT a blocker: a dev APP_KEY remains reachable in git history (START_BACKEND.ps1, removed in 090ca50). The production APP_KEY must be generated fresh on the host and must never be that value.
